title: 第九章 来嫂子怀里！
content_zh:
一段段玄妙的文字和图案如同潮水般涌进他的意识，经脉、穴位、灵气运转的路线，所有信息清晰得像是刻在脑子里一样。

    王大壮浑身一震，整个人像是被定住了一般，默默感受着脑海中涌现出的内容。

    仙武传承。

    一共分为三个阶段。

    第一阶段，炼气期。引天地灵气入体，淬炼筋骨经脉，打通任督二脉后，可力举千斤，身轻如燕，百病不侵。

    第二阶段，筑基期。灵气凝聚成丹，可外放真气，隔空伤人，御气而行，踏水无痕。

    第三阶段，金丹期。灵气化液，凝结金丹，可生死人肉白骨，移山填海，不在话下。

    至于后面目前还看不到，王大壮认为是跟自己的能力有关系。

    而每一个阶段的突破，都需要汲取足够多的天地灵气才能引动。

    王大壮睁开眼，眼里头全是狂喜。

    生死人肉白骨，移山填海——这是什么概念？这哪是什么武功，这分明就是神仙手段！

    他深吸一口气，压下心头的激动，试着按照脑海中法诀的指引去感应天地灵气。

    起初什么都没感觉到，但他不着急，一遍又一遍地默念法诀，渐渐地，他感觉到空气中有一种若有若无的清凉气息，像是清晨的薄雾，又像是山间的微风，丝丝缕缕地渗进他的皮肤，顺着经脉缓缓流淌。

    虽然极其微弱，但确实存在。

    王大壮心里头大喜，知道自己这条路走对了。

    “大壮，刚才是谁在门口呀？发生啥事儿了？”

    李玉梅的声音从灶房门口传来，她端着两盘菜走出来，一脸疑惑地看着站在院子中间发呆的王大壮。

    灶房里炒菜的声音太大，她刚才没听清楚外面的动静。

    王大壮回过神来，笑了笑，走过去接过她手里的菜盘子，随口说道：“没啥，就是两条狗在门口叫唤。一条是小黑，还有一条嘛……是母狗，可能发情了，现在被我赶跑了，没事了。”

    李玉梅听了后却是好笑起来：“我还以为是谁找我呢，不过你也真是的，母狗来了就让小黑配合一下呗，要是能生崽崽咱们到时候要一只。”

    “嫂子说得对，下次来的话我就不赶她走了。”王大壮嘿嘿直笑起来。
content_en:
Paragraphs of mysterious words and patterns poured into his consciousness like a tide. The meridians, acupuncture points, and the routes of spiritual energy circulation were all as clear as if they were engraved in his brain.

    Wang Dazhuang was shocked, and his whole body seemed to be frozen, silently feeling the contents in his mind.

    Immortal martial arts inheritance.

    There are three stages in total.

    The first stage is the Qi refining period. Introducing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the body, tempering the meridians of muscles and bones, and opening up the Rendu and Du meridians, one can lift a thousand kilograms with strength, and the body is as light as a swallow, and is immune to all diseases.

    The second stage is the foundation building period. The spiritual energy is condensed into a pill, which can release the true energy to the outside, hurt people through the air, travel with the energy, and leave no trace when stepping on water.

    The third stage is the golden elixir stage. Spiritual energy can be transformed into liquid and condensed into golden elixir, which can bring life and death to human flesh and bones, and can move mountains and fill seas.

    As for the fact that we can't see it yet, Wang Dazhuang thinks it has something to do with his ability.

    Each stage of breakthrough requires absorbing enough spiritual energy from heaven and earth to trigger it.

    Wang Dazhuang opened his eyes, filled with ecstasy.

    Human flesh and bones, living and dead, moving mountains and filling seas - what is this concept? What kind of martial arts is this? This is clearly a divine method!

    He took a deep breath, suppressed the excitement in his heart, and tried to sense the aura of heaven and earth according to the guidance of the magic formula in his mind.

    At first he felt nothing, but he was not in a hurry and recited the magic formula silently over and over again. Gradually, he felt a faint cool breath in the air, like the mist in the morning or the breeze in the mountains, seeping into his skin and flowing slowly along his meridians.

    Although extremely weak, it does exist.

    Wang Dazhuang was overjoyed and knew that he was on the right path.

    "Dazhuang, who was at the door just now? What happened?"

    Li Youmei's voice came from the kitchen door. She walked out with two plates of food and looked at Wang Dazhuang who was standing in the middle of the yard in a daze with confusion.

    The cooking sound in the kitchen was too loud, and she didn't hear clearly what was going on outside just now.

    Wang Dazhuang came back to his senses, smiled, walked over and took the dish from her hand, and said casually: "Nothing, just two dogs barking at the door. One is Xiaohei, and the other one... is a female dog, maybe in heat, and now I have chased him away. It's okay."

    After hearing this, Li Youmei started to laugh: "I thought it was someone who was looking for me, but you are also serious. When the bitch comes, just ask Xiao Hei to cooperate. If it can give birth to cubs, we will get one by then."

    "Sister-in-law is right, I won't drive her away next time she comes." Wang Dazhuang laughed.
title_en: Chapter 9 Come to my sister-in-law’s arms!
